author: Meandblu
title: Dishonest
content: This game is fun.  I never expected to win any real money but didn’t mind spending a little for entertainment.  I’ve had the long time and over time, have noticed sometimes a changing of scores or other player’s scores when games were being settled.  If you happen to play a couple of games while waiting for others to finish theirs, so you’re “distracted” the system completely switches things. I’ve noticed it more and more lately. At first I thought it maybe had a glitch from time to time and had a forgiving outlook.  Last night I encountered blatant scamming and took screen shots and sent a message to support.  I haven’t heard back and if I don’t by the end of the week. I will delete the app and move on.  As I said, I’m ok with paying a little to have fun, it’s like anything else in life.  But a flat out scam is a flat out scam and I’ll put my money elsewhere and warn others to do the same.

author: Native Columbine
title: Run from this game as fast as you can!
content:
I gave this app five stars so it would have prominence. But it really only deserves one star because it was fun. But that’s This where it ends. I also left this review elsewhere, but I wanted to make sure that it made it to this sector. This game has no ads, which is very nice. However, I kept asking myself, how are they making any money because it was very convenient to accumulate dollars and to cash them out to the third-party of your choosing, in my case, it was Venmo. They made it very clear that your designated dollar amount, in my case, of $300 would come in multiple deposits instead of one deposit of $300. This is where they get you because for every deposit, there was a withdrawal. And in the end I ended up with. A negative balance. Instead of receiving the actual $1400 that I was going to deposit I ended up with a negative balance. This is how they steal your money. This is how they make their money if you want to try and play the game because it is really fun. I truly was enjoying it, you need to have a separate checking account. I have yet to hear from them and will update this if anything changes to the positive.
        This is my update: things got so bad that I had to freeze my checking account and open up a new one. Then my Venmo account was suspended and they were barred from any future transactions. In the meantime, I sent them an email informing them that my bank was investigating them and the situation. They must heard me because before the Venmo account was suspended my balance went from a negative to a positive $700. But I won’t get any more money from them.
Players be wary!

author: Careful phone answerer!
title: This game is a TOTAL scam
content:
I have been playing for OVER 15 years and HAVE NOT WON A DIME!!  Having worked in a gambling organization for 30+ years, I know, for absolute certainty, that this game, like all gambling games, are rigged so that, unless I ‘bet’ a certain minimum amount of money I will NEVER WIN!!  
I have reported this game to the police and to the U.S. government, and, while I will continue to play the game, I am hoping that, one day before I die (I am 72) I will actually win some money!!
